findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "report_inaccuracy" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Report that something in the CrowdSpace catalogue is wrong or out of date — a minimum investment that no longer matches the platform, a regulator that changed, …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "report_inaccuracy" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Report that something in the CrowdSpace catalogue is wrong or out of date — a minimum investment that no longer matches the platform, a regulator that changed, …

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_regulatory_map" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
